mapper.select: WITH PaymentSum AS ( SELECT p.PAYMENT_NO, p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT, p.PAYMENT_DATE, m.EMPLOYER_NO FROM PAYMENT p JOIN PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP pm ON p.PAYMENT_NO = pm.PAYMENT_NO JOIN MEMBERSHIP m ON pm.MEMBERSHIP_NO = m.MEMBERSHIP_NO GROUP BY p.PAYMENT_NO, p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT, p.PAYMENT_DATE, m.EMPLOYER_NO ), RankedEmployers AS ( SELECT e.EMPLOYER_NO, e.BUSINESS_NAME, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, SUM(ps.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT, TO_CHAR(MAX(ps.PAYMENT_DATE), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:mm:ss') AS LATEST_PAYMENT_DATE, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY SUM(ps.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) DESC, MAX(ps.PAYMENT_DATE) DESC ) AS PAYMENT_RANK, CONCAT(BI.BUSINESS_IMG_PATH, BI.BUSINESS_IMG_RENAME) AS BUSINESS_IMG_URL FROM EMPLOYER e JOIN PaymentSum ps ON e.EMPLOYER_NO = ps.EMPLOYER_NO JOIN BUSINESS_IMG bi ON e.EMPLOYER_NO = bi.EMPLOYER_NO AND bi.BUSINESS_IMG_ORDER = 0 GROUP BY e.EMPLOYER_NO, e.BUSINESS_NAME, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, bi.BUSINESS_IMG_PATH, bi.BUSINESS_IMG_RENAME ) SELECT * FROM RankedEmployers WHERE PAYMENT_RANK <= 20

WITH LatestRecruitment AS ( SELECT r.RECRUITMENT_NO, r.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, r.EMPLOYER_NO, r.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, r.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL, r.SALARY_MOUNT, r.SALARY_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.EMPLOYER_NO ORDER BY r.WRITE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM RECRUITMENT r ) SELECT E.EMPLOYER_NO, E.BUSINESS_NAME, E.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, CONCAT(BI.BUSINESS_IMG_PATH, BI.BUSINESS_IMG_RENAME) AS BUSINESS_IMG_URL, LR.RECRUITMENT_NO, LR.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, WAT.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, S.SALARY_NAME, LR.SALARY_MOUNT FROM MEMBERSHIP M JOIN PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP PM ON M.MEMBERSHIP_NO = PM.MEMBERSHIP_NO JOIN EMPLOYER E ON E.EMPLOYER_NO = M.EMPLOYER_NO JOIN LatestRecruitment LR ON LR.EMPLOYER_NO = E.EMPLOYER_NO AND LR.RN = 1 -- 가장 최근 공고만 조인/공고없으면 조인 X LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_IMG BI ON E.EMPLOYER_NO = BI.EMPLOYER_NO AND BI.BUSINESS_IMG_ORDER = 0 -- 이미지가 없어도 조인 LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE WAT ON WAT.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = LR.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO JOIN SALARY s ON s.SALARY_NO = LR.SALARY_NO WHERE M.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE >= SYSDATE AND M.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE = ${type} AND LR.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' GROUP BY E.EMPLOYER_NO, E.BUSINESS_NAME, E.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, BI.BUSINESS_IMG_PATH, BI.BUSINESS_IMG_RENAME, LR.RECRUITMENT_NO, LR.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, LR.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, WAT.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, S.SALARY_NAME, LR.SALARY_MOUNT ORDER BY MAX(M.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE) DESC

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, e.BUSINESS_NAME, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, wt.TIME_NAME, wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, SALARY_MOUNT, s.SALARY_NAME FROM RECRUITMENT r LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE wat ON r.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO JOIN SALARY s ON s.SALARY_NO = r.SALARY_NO JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt ON wt.TIME_NO = r.TIME_NO JOIN EMPLOYER e ON e.EMPLOYER_NO = r.EMPLOYER_NO WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY WRITE_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
